title: Anyone else have weird dreams like me or just constantly "fever-dream" without feeling warm?
content: My dreams rarely ever make sense. I've seen mountain size contraptions and a Zord in a pool in my old elementary school. This seems like a good place to put here in case anyone else constantly fever dreams like me. Most of my friends have reoccurring dreams but I have never had the same dream twice or even have the same characters. Heck, I'm not even sure if I have dreamed of the same real person more than once. P.S I also have self-diagnosed ADHD because that may have something to do with it.
